name: set_wifi
description: Turn the phone's Wi-Fi radio on or off. Wi-Fi is also called wireless or WLAN.

action.description: on to enable Wi-Fi, off to disable Wi-Fi

name: set_hotspot
description: Turn the phone's mobile hotspot on or off, so other devices can share this phone's internet. The hotspot is also called tethering or a personal hotspot, and switching to the hotspot means turning it on.

action.description: on to enable the hotspot, off to disable the hotspot

name: set_torch
description: Turn the phone's flashlight on or off. The flashlight is also called the torch, the light or the lamp.

action.description: on to switch the flashlight on, off to switch the flashlight off

name: send_sms
description: Open a text message to a person the user named, with the message body already written, ready for the user to send.

recipient.description: the name of the person or the phone number the user named as the recipient of the message

message.description: the words the user dictated for the message body, copied word for word from the request

name: set_reminder
description: Set a reminder or an alarm that goes off at a time the user names, including waking the user up at a time.

when.description: the time phrase exactly as the user said it, for example 'at 5 PM' or 'tomorrow at 8:30'

text.description: what the reminder is about, copied word for word from the request
